description: Use when you need one ERC-20 balance for one wallet: balanceOf, decimals and symbol read in a single multicall on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism, with raw units, a decimal amount. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/erc20-balance, $0.002 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One token on one chain; for several tokens or chains at once use wallet_balance.
name: evm_erc20_balance
title: EVM ERC-20 balance
